itemData.name: Alfalfa
itemData.description: A perennial legume commonly used for grazing and hay. Its young sprouts are highly nutritious.

itemData.name: Apple
itemData.description: The fresh ripe red fruit that comes from a tree.

itemData.name: Artichoke
itemData.description: Green edible flower buds that are tasty if and only if expertly cooked.

itemData.name: Beetroot
itemData.description: A root vegetable that can make a good beat.

itemData.name: Blueberry
itemData.description: It's blue and it's a berry. Guess it: blueberry!

itemData.name: Cabbage
itemData.description: It's a leafy green and red and purple and white. A choose-your-fate veggie: pickled, fermented, steamed, stewed, roasted, sautéed, braised, or raw.

itemData.name: Carrot
itemData.description: It's an orange root veggie. May or may not give you night vision.

itemData.name: Corn
itemData.description: Also known as maize. It is a staple food, and a large majority is used to feed livestock.

itemData.name: Green Bean
itemData.description: One of the first three veggies you will probably think of.

itemData.name: Potato
itemData.description: Starchy root vegetable. Best when mashed with gravy.

itemData.name: Potato Seed
itemData.description: Budding sprout to grow the potato root vegetable.

itemData.name: Pumpkin
itemData.description: BOO! It's the popular orange squash used for pumpkin pies and Jack-O'-Lanterns.

itemData.name: Radish
itemData.description: It's a red root vegetable that tastes like a softer version of a carrot with a hint of spice.

itemData.name: Strawberry
itemData.description: It's straw and it's a berry. Actually, that's false. There is berry any straw.

itemData.name: Sweet Potato
itemData.description: POV: They offer you french fries but it's actually sweet potato fries. It's healthy though!

itemData.name: Watering Can
itemData.description: The solution to quench a plant's thirst.

itemData.name: Watermelon
itemData.description: A summer favorite treat. Tastes like sugary water with a side of friendship.

itemData.name: Wheat
itemData.description: A staple food. After processing, it becomes a refined grain perfect for breads and bagels.
